Hi,

Good timing on both fronts — here's where things stand:

Zendesk import: yes, we can bring across your tickets, comment threads, and requester email addresses. Heads up that macros, tags, and custom field definitions don't come across, so you'll want to rebuild those on our side once you're set up. Imports are queued and usually finish within 24 hours, though larger accounts can take a bit longer — worth kicking off soon if you're targeting end of next week.

Billing inbox: this is straightforward. Set up billing@ as one of your shared inboxes and restrict access to just your finance folks — you're on the Growth plan, which includes 5 shared inboxes, so you've got plenty of room. You can also add a rule to auto-assign anything landing on that address so it routes straight to that team without manual sorting.

Happy to help kick off the import whenever you're ready — just let me know and I'll get it queued.

Hi,

Happy to help get this moving. Before we can kick anything off, I need to know what system you're migrating from — we have dedicated importers for Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Gmail label exports, and each of those needs different credentials to run.

If you're coming from something else, we do have a CSV import path, but a heads-up: that only brings in contacts, not conversation history.

Once I know the source system, I'll need either admin credentials for it or an exported file to actually start the import. Imports are queued and usually complete within 24 hours, so if we can get the details from you today, we should be able to have everything in well before Monday.

Let me know which system you're on and how you'd like to proceed.

That matches a known issue on the ML-4402 where the VPN client caches the old credentials after a password change.

Can you try this first: clear the saved credential in the VPN client and re-authenticate. Steps are in KB article VPN-14. That resolves it in most cases.

If clearing the credential doesn't work, the unit will need a client reinstall - that requires a support session with us and takes about 30 minutes, so let me know right away if it fails so we can get that scheduled before Thursday.

One more thing for your on-site visit: we can't provide file share access outside the VPN, so if the reinstall path ends up being necessary and cuts it close, it's worth having a fallback. We can prepare an offline copy of the share in advance, but we need at least one business day's notice - so if you want that as a backup, let me know today and we'll get it ready.

Thanks for checking in. A couple of things on this:

The week of 22 December only has 3 working days on it (the rest are company holidays), so booking that week would use 3 of your 6 days, leaving you with 3 remaining. You'll need to submit the request through the HR portal, but heads up that it's your manager who approves it, not HR.

On carryover: policy caps it at 2 days into the new year, and whatever carries over has to be used by 31 March or it's forfeited. So if you take the 3 days for that week, you'd have 3 left - 2 could carry over, but the 3rd would need to be used before year-end or it's lost. Going above the 2-day cap requires director sign-off, and that's only granted when leave was cancelled at the company's request, so it wouldn't apply here.

Let me know if you want help figuring out how to use that extra day before the end of the year.

Hi,

Happy to help set up permissions so each person or team only has access to the inboxes they actually need, if that sounds like the right move for you. Just let me know how you'd like the inboxes divided up (or send over a rough idea of your team structure) and I can help configure it from there.
